title: OpenAI Compute Head Resigns to Launch Startup Before $750B Buildout
summary:
Double-digit gigawatts of compute capacity across sites in Ohio and Georgia and the launch of GPT-Infra in three months marked the tenure of Sachin Katti's leadership at OpenAI. Katti will leave his post as head of computing capacity next month to establish a new venture, though he will remain an advisor after Nov. 15. He built a network of infrastructure partners including Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD, Oracle, Microsoft, Google, AWS, and CoreWeave after joining the company in late 2025.

Uday Ruddarraju, who previously led infrastructure engineering at xAI and X, now leads the compute and infrastructure businesses. The department plans to spend $750 billion in the coming years on expansive capacity projects, including the Stargate data center effort. Ruddarraju joined OpenAI in July 2025 and served as compute CTO before his current appointment to lead the business.

selectedTweets.text:
After an incredible year at OpenAI, I'm moving on to build something new in a few weeks.

We secured double-digit GWs of compute across Ohio, Portsmouth, Georgia, Trainium and other projects with amazing partners including NVIDIA, Broadcom, AMD, Oracle, Microsoft, Google, AWS and CoreWeave. We also got GPT-Infra off the ground and going in just three months.

My journey from Stanford professor to entrepreneur, Intel business leader and CTO, and now scaling AI infrastructure at OpenAI has given me a unique perspective across the entire compute stack.

AI is reinventing computing. Excited to bring everything I've learned together to build what's next.

Grateful to the incredible OpenAI team. I'll continue as an advisor after November 15. More soon!
